name: Istrian identity
summary: Istrian identity (Istrianism) is a regionalist identity of the Croatian part of Istria, politically carried mainly by the Istrian Democratic Assembly. It stresses a distinct multicultural and bilingual (Croatian and Italian) region, anti-fascism, human rights and decentralization within Croatia, and sits in a pro-European, centre to centre-left liberal frame. It is not secessionist and opposes ethnic nationalism.
scope: The mainstream political Istrianism of the Istrian Democratic Assembly (IDS/DDI) since 1990, as documented by Wikipedia, an IDS statement by Valter Flego and scholarship by Zorko and Fontana. Economic and social-policy answers beyond regionalism are mostly inferred from the party's centre-left social-liberal label and are low confidence; the profile excludes Italian and Slovene Istria and irredentist currents.

sources.usedFor: Scholarly analysis: Istrianism as ambivalent identity, multicultural project, EU link.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: IDS protects private property and runs tourism-led policy but is social-liberal; sources give no stand on markets versus planning.

unions-good.rationale: Centre-left social-liberal parties are generally union-friendly; the sources are silent on labour.

property-fundamental.rationale: Protection of private property is listed among the IDS core principles, though not as an absolute override-proof right.

worker-ownership.rationale: Istrian regionalism centres on territory and identity, not worker ownership; a liberal party protecting private property would not endorse it.

strong-leader.rationale: IDS defined itself against Tudjman's hard-line nationalist rule and champions democracy and decentralization, so bypassing gridlock via a strongman is disfavoured.

state-harmful.rationale: IDS is a governing party that wants a stronger regional state and EU integration; the idea that the state is harmful is alien to it.

decide-locally.rationale: Valter Flego says decentralization must start being applied in practice as soon as possible, and Istria wants more powers and responsibility for its own development.

traditional-family.rationale: IDS is secular-liberal yet also defends Christian tradition in Istria per scholarship, so adherents are split; no direct source opened.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: The identity is about preserving a distinct regional culture and its bilingual heritage; it applies to the Istrian region rather than a nation, so only partly literal.

nation-first.rationale: IDS opposed Tudjman-style nationalism and is pro-European, so putting national interests above cooperation is disfavoured.

revolution-justified.rationale: A liberal, democratic, coalition-governing party that seeks change through elections and autonomy within Croatia.

tax-inheritance.rationale: Inheritance taxation is absent from the sources about the party and identity.

basic-income.rationale: A basic income appears in none of the opened sources on IDS or Istrianism.

abolish-money-wages.rationale: Incompatible with a liberal party that protects private property.

abolish-central-banks.rationale: Pro-European liberal party; the EU monetary system is accepted.

corporatist-bargaining.rationale: Not an IDS idea; liberal party would prefer free bargaining.

one-party-rule.rationale: IDS is a multiparty democratic party that opposed the one-party legacy and supports human rights; the idea is alien.

democracy-best.rationale: Democracy and human rights are core principles of the party.

workers-councils.rationale: Not a socialist-council ideology; party is liberal and parliamentary.

right-to-secede.rationale: Istrianism seeks autonomy and decentralization within Croatia, not secession, so a right to secede is not a platform plank.

natural-rulers.rationale: Contradicts the liberal, democratic principles of the party.

war-builds-character.rationale: Opposed to Tudjman-style militant nationalism and pro-European.

separate-church-state.rationale: Secularism is described as one base of Istrian regional consciousness in summaries I saw, though IDS also defends Christian tradition.

private-courts-defense.rationale: Not an IDS position; liberal party relies on the state.

ethnic-nation.rationale: Flego praises multiculturalism, minority rights and unity regardless of national or religious affiliation, the opposite of an ethnic-nation view.

colonial-reparations.rationale: Colonial reparations have no connection to Istrian regional politics in the sources.

duties-before-rights.rationale: Flego stresses unconditional respect for human rights, which points against subordinating rights to duties.

industrial-civilization-disaster.rationale: Not an Istrian regionalist idea; tourism-industrial region.

direct-action.rationale: Party works through elections and coalitions.

return-to-foraging.rationale: Not remotely an Istrian regionalist idea.

abolish-division-of-labor.rationale: Not compatible with a liberal market-friendly party.

profit-exploitation.rationale: Liberal protection of private property and business is inconsistent with this Marxist claim.

dictatorship-of-proletariat.rationale: IDS is liberal, democratic and anti-authoritarian.

individual-rights-only.rationale: IDS defends minority and group-linked rights such as bilingualism and minority protection, which conflicts with a pure individual-only view.

conscription.rationale: Croatia ended conscription; no documented IDS position; liberal profile.

exit-over-voice.rationale: A voice-and-autonomy regionalist movement values democratic participation over exit.

hereditarian-race.rationale: Inconsistent with a multicultural, tolerant, anti-fascist identity.

organic-representation.rationale: IDS operates as a political party; not corporatist.

total-state.rationale: A liberal human-rights party that opposed authoritarian nationalism.

territorial-expansion.rationale: Opposed to militant nationalism; wants cross-border cooperation, not expansion.

personal-loyalty-rule.rationale: Feudal oath-based rule is alien to this democratic regionalist movement.

universal-morality.rationale: Human rights are called unconditional by Flego, implying universalism, but philosophical claims are not made.

revive-national-language.rationale: Istrian multilingualism treats Italian and Croatian as equal; reviving a single language as state language is not the aim.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: Fiscal stance on deficits is not in the opened sources.

national-self-determination.rationale: Istrians seek regional autonomy within Croatia; national statehood self-determination is not the aim, and the party is not nationalist.

reason-over-faith.rationale: Secular tendencies but IDS defends Christian tradition; split.

sacrifice-heritage.rationale: The identity is built on cultural heritage and local culture.

state-class-instrument.rationale: The Marxist theory of the state is not part of this liberal regionalist identity.

assimilate-immigrants.rationale: Multiculturalism and respect for minorities are central values.

elite-replacement.rationale: A conspiracy view incompatible with its tolerant anti-fascist outlook.

national-mission.rationale: Istrian regionalism and its anti-nationalist stance leave no room for a national mission.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: IDS is itself a long-governing elite party; a populist anti-elite view is not its stance.

discourage-race-mixing.rationale: Multiculturalism and coexistence are core themes.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Flego cites unconditional respect for human rights and unity regardless of national or religious affiliation.

ban-cattle-slaughter.rationale: Not an Istrian issue; liberal profile.

no-religion-state-schools.rationale: Secular tendencies versus Catholic inland voters; split and undocumented.

state-strengthens-encirclement.rationale: A Marxist-Leninist state doctrine foreign to this liberal regionalism.

population-transfer.rationale: Multiculturalism and coexistence are core; transfers conflict with them.

competition-drives-progress.rationale: Peoples-struggle framing conflicts with the coexistence ethos.

separated-powers.rationale: Democratic liberal party; decentralization is a related idea.

priority-to-poor.rationale: A preferential option for the poor is not found in the sources on IDS.

population-causes-poverty.rationale: The idea is not part of Istrian regionalism or IDS programmes in the sources.

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: Flego calls multiculturalism and bilingualism a signpost for Croatia and says coexistence is real.

representatives-worker-pay.rationale: Capping politicians' pay at workers' wages is not an IDS idea in the sources.

party-discipline-binding.rationale: IDS itself disciplined Miletic and he left, yet no doctrine on this.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: IDS is pro-European, joined ALDE, held the European Integration ministry and wants a cross-border euro-region.

defeat-own-government-war.rationale: Revolutionary defeatism is foreign to this liberal democratic identity.

censor-art-for-virtue.rationale: Liberal democratic principles oppose moral censorship of art.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: Croatia is in NATO and EU; party pro-European.

people-in-arms.rationale: A citizen militia is not part of IDS thinking in the sources.

abolish-rental-housing.rationale: Banning rentals is alien to a tourism-based economy with a large rental market.

reunify-divided-nation.rationale: IDS wants a cross-border euro-region covering all Istria, which resembles cooperation, not reunification as a single state.

educated-out-of-touch.rationale: Anti-intellectual themes are not part of the sources on Istrian identity.

cultures-equal-different.rationale: Multiculturalism and equal status of Italian and Croatian point to cultural equality.

minority-language-support.rationale: Flego names minority rights and Istria's bilingualism as the signpost; equal status of Italian and Croatian is core IDS policy per Wikipedia.

independence-needs-economic-change.rationale: Anti-colonial economic arguments do not apply to Istrian regionalism.

independent-nuclear-deterrent.rationale: Nuclear weapons are absent from IDS concerns and contrary to its pro-European stance.

no-land-for-peace.rationale: Peace-for-land questions do not apply to the Istrian context in the sources.

subordinate-church-to-state.rationale: Secular but also defends Christian tradition; not a plank.

force-to-prevent-secession.rationale: Not a secessionist movement itself but favours autonomy and opposed Tudjman nationalism, so using force against regions is disfavoured.

class-struggle-under-socialism.rationale: A Maoist doctrine foreign to this liberal regionalist identity.

apostasy-punishable.rationale: Liberal and secular principles reject criminal punishment for leaving a religion.

common-currency.rationale: Pro-European party; Croatia adopted the euro and IDS supports European integration.

kin-peoples-union.rationale: Istrian identity is regional and mixed, not kin-based.

national-cultural-autonomy.rationale: Bilingualism and minority rights fit, though Istrian identity is regional rather than a minority nation.

moral-incentives.rationale: Guevarist moral incentives are foreign to a liberal market-friendly party.

public-money-creation.rationale: Monetary reform is not an IDS idea in the sources; the pro-EU line accepts the existing system.

former-empire-influence.rationale: The aim is not part of Istrian regionalism and clashes with its anti-nationalist stance.

labor-aristocracy.rationale: A Marxist-Leninist theory foreign to this liberal regionalist identity.

freedom-to-discriminate.rationale: Opposed to discrimination; anti-fascist and tolerant.

colonial-treaties-void.rationale: Colonial border treaties do not apply to the Istrian context.

minority-veto.rationale: Minority protection but not individual vetoes.

mass-culture-pacifies.rationale: Critical theory of mass culture is not an IDS idea in the sources.

ruling-class-consent.rationale: Gramscian hegemony theory is not part of this regionalist identity in the sources.

world-economy-extracts-surplus.rationale: Dependency theory is not part of Istrian regionalism in the sources.

native-born-offices.rationale: Contradicts multicultural inclusion and unity across affiliation.

return-lost-territory.rationale: Opposed to nationalist irredentism; cross-border cooperation instead.

indigenous-political-leadership.rationale: Not applicable to Istria, whose population is mixed and long layered.

antifascism-founding-value.rationale: Anti-fascism is listed as a core IDS principle in the Wikipedia article.

foreign-takeover-block.rationale: Pro-EU open market; Istria tourism uses foreign investment.

recallable-delegates.rationale: Nulled (statement review, 2026-11-11): its value turns on whether representatives must follow binding instructions, and the statement now asks only whether voters can recall them at any time.

reviewHistory.rationale: Imperative mandates are a council-democracy idea foreign to IDS.
reviewHistory.author: claude-sonnet-5-5

reviewHistory.rationale: Nulled (statement review, 2026-11-11): its value turns on whether representatives must follow binding instructions, and the statement now asks only whether voters can recall them at any time.
reviewHistory.author: claude-opus-5-5

single-official-language.rationale: IDS core policy is equal status of Italian and Croatian and Istrian bilingualism, directly opposing a sole language.

foreign-land-ownership.rationale: EU single market norms; tourism region.

arm-foreign-insurgents.rationale: Covert warfare is contrary to the pro-European liberal profile and not an IDS idea.

no-duty-to-obey.rationale: A rule-of-law party would not endorse a general right to disobey.

non-intervention.rationale: No documented IDS position; pro-multilateral outlook weakly disfavours absolute non-intervention.

abolish-legal-marriage.rationale: Ending legal marriage is not an IDS idea in the sources.

deference-to-leading-power.rationale: Tributary order is alien to this democratic regionalism.

religion-illusion.rationale: Not a Marxist movement; Catholic tradition respected.

purge-loanwords.rationale: Multilingual hybrid Istrian culture contradicts linguistic purism.

cooperative-communities.rationale: Utopian communalism is not an IDS idea in the sources.

punish-blasphemy.rationale: Liberal secular principles oppose blasphemy laws.

defensive-jihad-duty.rationale: An Islamist doctrine irrelevant to this movement.

unreligious-rulers-fought.rationale: Liberal secular principles oppose takfiri rebellion.

alienated-labor.rationale: Marxist alienation theory is not part of this identity in the sources.

divine-source-of-authority.rationale: Divine authority contradicts the democratic secular principles of the party.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: Pacifist disarmament is not an IDS idea in the sources; Croatia is in NATO.

interest-free-mutual-credit.rationale: Mutualist banking is not an IDS idea in the sources.

interfaith-marriage-restriction.rationale: Liberal secular and multicultural principles oppose restricting interfaith marriage.

state-promotes-atheism.rationale: Liberal party that defends Christian tradition among voters.

abolish-police-prisons.rationale: Abolitionism is not an IDS idea in the sources.

abolish-ip.rationale: Abolishing patents is not an IDS idea in the sources.

never-kill-self-defence.rationale: Absolute pacifism is not an IDS idea in the sources.

unbroken-national-continuity.rationale: Zorko and Fontana show Istrianism is ambivalent, constructed and multi-ethnic, not an unbroken ancient national line.

single-unit-for-people.rationale: Istrian identity is regional, not one-people-one-unit; IDS wants a cross-border Istrian region which comes close but is multi-ethnic.

socialism-needs-workers-power.rationale: Socialist definition debates are not part of this liberal identity.

municipal-property.rationale: Municipalist ownership is not an IDS idea in the sources.

confederal-coordination.rationale: Decentralization is core but confederal municipalism is a specific anarchist idea.

regional-powers-revocable.rationale: The aim is greater powers and responsibility for Istria, so revocable devolution contradicts its demand.

language-defines-nation.rationale: Istrian identity unites Croats and Italians and others across languages, rejecting language-defined nations.

foreign-partition-plot.rationale: Conspiracy thinking about partition is not part of IDS.

soldiers-refuse-war.rationale: Refusal of orders is not an IDS idea in the sources.

keep-nuclear-weapons.rationale: Nuclear arsenals do not concern this movement in the sources.

customary-chiefs-lawmaking.rationale: Not applicable and contrary to democratic principles.

internet-shutdowns.rationale: Human rights principles oppose cutting internet access for order.

women-suffrage.rationale: Basic democratic liberal rights are core.

land-use-tenure.rationale: A party that lists protection of private property as a core principle rejects tenure by use only.

intervene-in-bloc.rationale: Anti-nationalist, pro-European liberal party opposes great-power coercion of allies.

extrajudicial-killing.rationale: IDS stresses human rights and a pro-European liberal frame, which rule out killing without trial.

resources-common-ownership.rationale: Nothing in the sources addresses the question; a centre-left liberal party is split on it.

bypass-parties-groups.rationale: IDS is itself a party built on regional pluralism and democratic decentralization, so bypassing parties is contrary to its approach.

former-empire-equal-treatment.rationale: The aim is not part of Istrian regionalism and clashes with its anti-nationalist stance. (Carried over from former-empire-influence, "A country should cultivate political and cultural influence in regions once ruled by its predecessor empire.", with the value reversed, 2026-11-11.)

missingStatements.text: Two official languages should have equal status in a region where both communities live.
missingStatements.rationale: Equal status of Italian and Croatian in Istria is a core IDS policy and Flego names Istrian bilingualism as a signpost.

missingStatements.text: Regions should have the right to a larger share of political and fiscal powers within their country.
missingStatements.rationale: IDS advocates decentralization of Croatia and Flego calls for regional powers and responsibility for development.

missingStatements.text: Neighbouring regions across a national border should form joint cross-border regions with shared institutions.
missingStatements.rationale: IDS promotes a cross-border Istrian euro-region and the Adriatic Euroregion.
missingStatements.declined: Cross-border euroregions are a narrow European policy.

notes: Many answers outside regionalism, multiculturalism, anti-fascism and EU integration are low confidence inferences from the centre-left social-liberal label. Scholarship notes IDS also defends Christian tradition among inland voters, so social-issue answers are split-prone.
